name: OceanMail
description: OceanMail Desktop alpha: transforms Thunderbird's native shell into OceanMail — reliable cold-start initialization (Station, Emergency, Available, and Sent integration are present before any user interaction), native Mail with an account-scoped Available pseudo-folder (explicit accessible reorder controls), a real per-account Saved folder positioned after Available, native Sent augmented with a native OceanMail Status delivery column (truthful for real messages, hidden outside OceanMail accounts) and a view-mode-aware Sent-details banner, a compose-time Important toggle backed by native message-priority metadata, native Local Folders hidden from the folder pane, plus native Spaces-toolbar destinations for Station and Emergency — scoped only to explicitly provisioned OceanMail accounts, with the Station API integration boundary.
